## Causes of the French Revolution

**Social and Political Structure**
France in the late 18th century was divided into three rigid estates. The First Estate (clergy) and the Second Estate (nobility) owned much of the land, held the highest offices, and were largely exempt from taxation. The Third Estate—comprising peasants, urban workers
